description: Install an account SSH key (list_vserver_account_ssh_keys) on the VPS as root authorized key. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: add_vserver_ssh_key
title: Install SSH Key on VPS
